context: Hello, I'm here to help find you a movie trailer!
Excellent. I appreciate the help. I want to find a good movie to take my girlfriend to this weekend.
What was the last movie you two saw together, did she enjoy it?
The last movie we saw together was Star Wars Rise of Skywalker which she enjoyed but admittedly, we saw it for me. She enjoys comedies more than action.
Haha, ok.  Are you looking for more of a general comedy film or something perhaps more romantic?
I'd be willing to go with either or one that's both. I'm just not sure what's out there in those categories.
Is there an actor or actress in particular that you know she likes?
She likes Ryan Reynolds. The Deadpool guy. She even says I look a little him. I don't see it. Maybe like his older brother. She loved him and Sandra Bullock in The Proposal.
Alright, let me see what I can find!
Thanks for the help. I appreciate it very much. I'm looking forward to spending time together and treating her to a good movie.
How do you feel about Jumanji: The Next Level? It's a mix of goofy comedy and action with the likes of Kevin Heart, Jack Black, and Dwayne Johnson.
That has potential. Isn't Dwayne Johnson 'The Rock'?
Yup, I think he dropped the moniker awhile back when he got serious about acting.
Right. That does look good and I'll make that first on my list. But do have one more recommendation for me as a back-up plan?
Shockingly there isn't a lot in theaters at the moment, would you be opposed to watching something at home? Otherwise there's Sonic and Bad Boys for Life.
I'll take a look at both of those. If we do decide to stay home, is there a romantic comedy that you recommend?

If you don't mind watching something a little older, the original Overboard with Kurt Russell and Goldie Hawn. Those two have been an adorable couple in Hollywood for years and the film is a classic romantic comedy as far as I'm concerned. I can tell you a little bit about it if you're interested.
The classics are always a nice switch. Tell me about it!

Goldie Hawn plays an uptight high society type who cheats the carpenter (Kurt Russell) who is working on her yacht. After an accident gives her amnesia, he finds her and convinces her they're husband and wife. It sounds a bit dodgy but it's actually pretty adorable, especially when his kids get involved.
Awww. That actually sounds perfect! Even if we see something in the theater, I'm definitely taking this recommendation. Thank you so much for your help!
Great, I really hope you two enjoy whatever you decide to see! I'll send the trailer for Overboard straight away, bye and take care.

context.content: Hi there! I'm looking for a new movie to watch. You: Hi! I'd be happy to help you find a new movie. Can you tell me what kind of movies you like to watch? Do you have a favorite genre or type of movie?
Hey! I love comedies. They always put a smile on my face. I also enjoy movies that are a bit quirky and have a touch of heart.

Awesome! Quirky comedies with heart are a great choice. I have a few movies that might fit the bill. Can you tell me if you have a preference for movies that are set in a specific time period, such as classic or modern?
I prefer modern settings. Classic movies are nice, but I usually lean towards something more contemporary.
I've got a few modern quirky comedies that might interest you. I'd like to recommend one movie that I think you'll really enjoy. Have you seen 'The Favourite' (2018)?
The Favourite sounds interesting, but I'm not sure if it fits the comedy genre. Could you give me more details about it?

I can tell you more about 'The Favourite' (2018). It's a period comedy-drama that follows the story of Queen Anne and her two advisors, who engage in a series of absurd and witty power struggles. It's a clever and entertaining film with great performances from the cast.
Hmm, it does sound intriguing, but I'm more interested in a comedy that's a bit lighter and funnier. Maybe something with more humor and less drama?

I understand what you mean. While 'The Favourite' does have its comedic moments, it's not a traditional comedy. Let me think for a moment... Ah, I've got it! I'd like to recommend 'My Favorite Year' (1982) instead. It's a classic comedy about a young comedian who becomes the writer for a popular TV show, and hilarity ensues. This movie has a great balance of humor and heart, and it's a fun and lighthearted watch.
My Favorite Year sounds perfect! It seems to have the right mix of humor and heart. Can you tell me more about the plot and the main characters?

My Favorite Year (1982) is a comedy film that takes place in 1954. The main character, Sandy, is a young comedian who is hired as the writer for a popular TV show. Sandy's job is to come up with comedy sketches, but he's struggling to find his place in the industry. He becomes fast friends with the show's star, Alan King, who teaches him the ropes and helps him find his comedic voice. The movie follows Sandy's journey as he navigates the challenges of working in show business and learns to find his own unique style.
That sounds like a great plot! I'm excited to see how Sandy's journey unfolds. Can you tell me more about the actors and their performances?

My Favorite Year (1982) features a talented cast, including Peter O'Toole, Mark Linn-Baker, and Jessica Harper. Peter O'Toole is particularly memorable in the film, bringing his signature wit and charm to the role of Alan King. Mark Linn-Baker shines as the young and struggling comedian, Sandy. The chemistry between the leads is undeniable, and their performances add to the movie's humor and heart.
I'm really looking forward to watching this movie. It sounds like it will be a delightful experience. [END]
